assignments.name: Set_Confidence_High
assignments.label: Set Confidence High
assignments.description: Every evidence signal is present. Signals-missing is written as empty rather than left alone, so a record that has just been completed does not keep advertising gaps it no longer has.

assignments.name: Set_Confidence_Low
assignments.label: Set Confidence Low
assignments.description: A hard evidence failure: no verified financials, intake could not read the statement, or no current bureau file. This is the band the escalation action treats as its primary trigger.

assignments.name: Set_Confidence_Medium
assignments.label: Set Confidence Medium
assignments.description: The evidence base is sound but the applicant profile is incomplete. Assessable, with a named gap to close.

constants.name: CONFIDENCE_LOW
constants.description: Evidence base is broken. The escalation action keys on this exact value as its primary trigger, so the two must be changed together.

decisions.name: Confidence_Band
decisions.label: Confidence Band?
decisions.description: Bands are evaluated in order and the first match wins, which is what resolves the overlap between the Low and Medium definitions: a record missing both verified financials and a complete profile is Low, because the harder failure governs. Every condition is a presence check. Deliberately no condition reads the credit SCORE or the disparity PERCENTAGE — those measure how good the deal is, and letting them move this field would turn a completeness signal into a lending opinion.

Flow.description: Deterministic grounding confidence: measures whether the evidence needed to assess this application is present, and never whether the application is any good. Stored as a band (100/50/20 on a Percent field), not a continuous score — the field renders as a percentage, so 100.00% reads as complete evidence. Runs before save, so it writes to the same record with no DML and cannot recurse. Order against the disparity flow is deliberately unconstrained: triggerOrder is rejected by FlowStart at v67, and it is not needed, because the two flows read and write disjoint field sets — neither consumes anything the other produces. formulas.name: fmlSignalsMissing
formulas.description: The raw list with its trailing separator removed. Written to Grounding_Signals_Missing__c so the escalation reason and the agent evidence trail can name the gaps without re-deriving this logic in a second place.

formulas.name: fmlSignalsMissingRaw
formulas.description: Semicolon-separated list of absent signals, in the same order the decision evaluates them. Carries a trailing separator that fmlSignalsMissing strips. Names the missing evidence only — never a figure — so the string stays safe at Internal classification.
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!$Record.Verified_Annual_Revenue__c}) || ISBLANK({!$Record.Verified_Net_Income__c}), "verified financials; ", "") & IF({!$Record.Needs_Financial_Review__c}, "statement review gate; ", "") & IF(BLANKVALUE({!$Record.Current_Credit_Checks__c}, 0) = 0, "current credit check; ", "") & IF(ISBLANK({!$Record.Applicant__c}) || ISBLANK(TEXT({!$Record.Security_Type__c})) || ISBLANK({!$Record.Declared_Annual_Revenue__c}), "complete applicant profile; ", "")
